mapper.insert: insert into message (title, content, receiver_account, type, is_read, create_time, related_id) values (#{title}, #{content}, #{receiverAccount}, #{type}, #{isRead}, now(), #{relatedId})
mapper.select: select count(*) from message where receiver_account = #{account} and is_read = 0
select * from message where receiver_account = #{account} order by create_time desc
mapper.update: update message set is_read = 1 where id = #{id}
update message set is_read = 1 where receiver_account = #{account} and related_id = #{relatedId}
